# V-fold pop-up

> Keystone test fixture: a faithful minimal sheet cartridge. Replaced by a real commons
> cartridge when the sheet commons is first pinned.

A rhombus of card folded on its long diagonal is glued across the gutter of a spread,
each half at `v_angle` to the gutter. Opening the spread pulls the glue lines apart and
the piece stands up; closing it folds the piece flat inside.

Interfaces: `gutter` (the spread's fold, neutral) and `glue_flaps` (the piece's two
tabs, male) — a pop-up piece declaring a glue flap mounts on any spread exposing a
gutter, checked before anything is cut.
